fact: At 30 June 2025 the digital ministry's 2025 annual work plan stood at 43.61% physical execution, with 3,281,196,260 F CFA spent of a 30,377,644,070 F CFA annual forecast, a 10.80% financial execution rate.
title: Le ministère en charge de la transition digitale se met au diapason pour davantage d'impact tangible et durable de ses interventions sur le terrain
